command:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${LABEL_SELECTOR:?LABEL_SELECTOR is required}"
pods=$(kubectl get pods -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" -l "$LABEL_SELECTOR" -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
read -r -a targets <<< "$pods"
if [[ ${#targets[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "Expected exactly one primary for $LABEL_SELECTOR; found ${#targets[@]}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
target="${targets[0]}"
echo "Backing up PostgreSQL target $POD_NAMESPACE/$target"
kubectl exec -i -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" "$target" -c "$CONTAINER_NAME" -- bash -s < /scripts/script.sh
echo "Backup command completed for $POD_NAMESPACE/$target"
containers.name: backup
